README

Recorded documentation

Upstream documentation. Cargo examples describe the Rust crate; Add to project provides the Oven dependency.

README.md · Author-provided

futures-channel

Channels for asynchronous communication using futures-rs.

Usage

Add this to your Cargo.toml:

[dependencies]
futures-channel = "0.3"

The current futures-channel requires Rust 1.71 or later.

Reporting & security

Abuse reporting and a confidential registry security contact are not configured in this playground. No report is sent here.

For a package vulnerability, follow its upstream repository’s security policy. You can find its source link in the package’s Metadata section.
